posts.name: Yash Raj
posts.cooked:
On 16th August I gave oppe of SC , that day also the vm was lagging alot I made alot complaint , after that they provided extra time for 30 minutes but then also I was not able to pass that oppe.

Today on 23rd August I appeared for RE OPPE but the same issue happened all the time on VM terminal, I complaint to instructor 3-4 time then also he just said to check the internet connection but it was fine as there was no problem happening on gmeet and exam portal , only vm was lagging,

I was not able to write , solutions my speed affected alot , I am not the only student who suffer, and I can assure you that the problem was not on my device and internet, as same problem happend last time , they accepted also last time but this time not , they didn’t provide any extra time,

May be the Total marks I will get in REOPPE will not be sufficient to pass but this time mistake is not from my side and I want solution as this oppe was compulsory for getting course grade.

Provide any solution pr resolution. same problem happend two times. I have also given oppe of PDSA but I got 60 marks and portal was working fine , problem is with VM.

And what I am saying you can also check on the recording which happened during the exam of my laptop screen.

@sayan @Subendu

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Throughout the OPPE we have monitored the VM and it has been up and responsive the whole time, if there is any such lag, it is known to be user side network issue. Your other websites need not be slow for that to happen. Many ISPs have slow ssh connection, it is a known issue. Please try with different network.

posts.name: Yash Raj
posts.cooked: @sayan Sir , if this is the way things will go upon , next term also I will not be able to clear this oppe , because even in 5g speed , and with gmeet and exam portal working fine , the vm problem will not allow me to pass. That’s all I want to say . My again one term will be wasted without any fault from myside and no body taking responsiblity.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: It is not about speed, if your ISP has some issues in the ssh tunnelling, then it will feel laggy. The VM has been working fine throughout the OPPE from our side, and most students did not face this. For the ones who did it is a client side network issue, simply try with a different network.

posts.name: Yash Raj
posts.cooked: But my question is still the same why the team took responsibilty on 16th ,as that day also exact same issue was there.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: On 16th there was an actual system issue, wherein the system was actually out of resources and lagging for all.
